segments.name: Outdoor
segments.description: A group of authentic outdoor-based lifestyle brands selling performance and performance-inspired outdoor apparel, footwear, equipment and accessories to consumers globally.
segments.evidence: Our Outdoor segment is a group of authentic outdoor-based lifestyle brands.

segments.name: Active
segments.description: A group of activity-based lifestyle brands offering active apparel, footwear, backpacks, luggage, handbags, totes and accessories to consumers globally.
segments.evidence: Our Active segment is a group of activity-based lifestyle brands.

revenueModel.text: VF earns revenue from wholesale customers such as specialty stores, national chains and department stores, from consumers through its own direct-to-consumer stores and e-commerce sites, and from licensees paying royalties on licensed product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Each licensee pays royalties to VF based on its sales of licensed products, with most agreements providing for a minimum royalty requirement.

changes.text: In 2024, VF sold the Supreme brand business, which was reported as a discontinued operation.
changes.evidence: On October 1, 2024, VF completed the sale of Supreme.

changes.text: In 2025, VF sold the Dickies brand business, which remained in continuing operations through the date of sale.
changes.evidence: On November 12, 2025, VF completed the sale of Dickies.

changes.text: In the first quarter of Fiscal 2026, VF realigned its reportable segments, combining Timberland and Timberland PRO into one operating segment aggregated with The North Face in the Outdoor segment.
changes.evidence: In the first quarter of Fiscal 2026, VF realigned its reportable segments to reflect a change in how the Timberland ® brand is managed and the CODM's key areas of focus.
